_comment: Session 3 fixture-wiring map: which local seed file/format `inventory:build --state assam` should ingest for each config/sources.assam.yaml source ID. Deliberately kept OUT of config/sources.assam.yaml (see docs/session-log.md 'Session 3' for the full reasoning): config describes audit policy (which sources exist, whether they are enabled, their sourceType), not this pre-live-crawl session's fixture wiring. Once Session 17 performs real research and Session 4+'s crawler exists, this file's role is superseded by actual HTTP fetches; it is a placeholder ingestion map for exercising the adapters and pipeline before live crawling is authorized (implementation.md section 12.5's legal-risk gate).
